Leyla (CS): NexusTel asked for a short promo onboarding: need me-central-1 routing, partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO, and a temporary QPS increase for two weeks. Also mentioned eventual Private deploy + KMS.

Omar (NexusTel): We want a 10-day runway. Peak 09:00-21:00 GST. Can we raise to 1,000 QPS from 250 baseline? CIDRs: 197.55.10.0/24 and 197.55.11.45/32. Egress ~300Mbps.

Priya (NetOps): I'll open peering request for me-central-1. Confirmed we can do ephemeral allowlist with auto-revoke. Any TLS client certs?

Omar (NexusTel): No client certs for initial test, token auth only.

Hannah (Solutions Eng): Proposed actions: 1) ephemeral allowlist (auto-revoke 2025-05-05), 2) apply "promo-1k" QPS policy scoped to /v1/generate and limited embeddings, 3) SAML setup call (30m), 4) Private deploy discovery note for Q3.

Noah (AE): Renewal risk flagged 11 they need region residency proof & KMS isolation statement. I'll draft the renewal artifact with Security.

Leyla (CS): I'll schedule the SAML call tomorrow 10:30 GST. Omar, confirm routes: generate + embeddings (embeddings cap 200 concurrent).

provision-bot: Ticket INF-4621 created. Peering PoP reservation ETA 18h. Promo profile applied to staging. Auto-revoke timer set.

Priya (NetOps): Checklist posted in INF-4621: peering, allowlist, promo-1k policy (09:00-21:00 GST), monitoring alert at 75% -> @Leyla.

Omar (NexusTel): Thanks all — please keep allowlist temporary.

Leyla (CS): Recap in INF-4621 and renewal doc assigned to Noah. Ping here for changes.

(END)
